# Script to run Exonerate agains a reference CDS to identify the genes present in the neo region of the sex chromosome


```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#!/bin/bash -l
#SBATCH -J exonerate
#SBATCH --mail-type FAIL,DONE
#SBATCH --mail-user Julia.Levinstein@campus.lmu.de
#SBATCH -t 2-00:00:00
#SBATCH --clusters=biohpc_gen
#SBATCH --partition=biohpc_gen_normal
#SBATCH --mem=4G
#SBATCH -n 1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1


#Configuration
WORKING_DIR=/dss/dsslegfs01/pr53da/pr53da-dss-0036/projects/2025__neosex/neosex_project/fusion_dating
SPECIES=Pte_gut
CLADE=Pterocliformes
CHR=4 #Z or W
GENES=autosomal_genes
FUSION_CHR=4



REF_FILE="$WORKING_DIR/Ref/Ref_chr${FUSION_CHR}_cds_filter.fasta"
TARGET_FILE="$WORKING_DIR/$CLADE/$GENES/Species/$SPECIES/data/${SPECIES}_chr${CHR}.fasta"
OUTPUT_FILE="${SPECIES}_${CHR}_cds_mappings_chr_${FUSION_CHR}.gff"

CONDA_ENV_PATH="/dss/dsslegfs01/pr53da/pr53da-dss-0036/projects/2025__neosex/conda_envs/bio_env"
conda activate "$CONDA_ENV_PATH"

exonerate \
  --model est2genome \
  --percent 65 \
  --softmasktarget true \
  --softmaskquery false \
  --showtargetgff true \
  --showalignment true \
  --minintron 2 \
  --maxintron 50000 \
  "$REF_FILE" \
  "$TARGET_FILE" > "$WORKING_DIR/$CLADE/$GENES/Species/$SPECIES/results/$OUTPUT_FILE"

```
